SHOPWARE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: The sales channel access key, sent as a header by headless frontends and mobile apps. Shopware's own reference storefront names it under a NUXT_PUBLIC_ prefix, which is the basis here. Generating a new one invalidates the old at once.

SHOPWARE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: For the admin API, which uses an OAuth pair rather than that header. Shopware documents the field names rather than variables, so this name is convention.

SHOPWARE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: The other half of that pair. Self-hosted, so your own installation issues both.
